closest_collisions: Mattar & Daw 2018: expected-value prioritized memory access/replay.
RoMeRL 2026: explicit memory-reward trap and utility-state control for self-evolving agent memory.
Forget to Improve 2026: net-value-per-byte memory curation under hard budgets.

difference_remaining: CMX combines per-memory leave-one-out marginal utility, explicit context rent and strict procedural-only semantic scope, but no evidence shows this combination is superior or novel enough to justify a new architecture.
